newsitem.title: GERMANY: German schoolgirl found dead, police suspect murder.
newsitem.headline: German schoolgirl found dead, police suspect murder.

text.p: A 14-year-old German girl missing since Friday was found dead in a swamp near her school on Saturday and police said they suspected she was murdered by a stalker and could have been sexually abused.

Police in the northwestern city of Leverkusen said they were searching for a man of about 30 years of age with dark hair and a black jacket who was observed following the girl on her way to school when she was last seen on Friday morning.
"The schoolgirl was probably killed," a police spokesman said. "A sex crime cannot be ruled out."

The girl, whom police identified as Sabine W., was last seen on her one km (half a mile) walk to school on Friday morning, police said. A 16-year-old classmate told police said he had seen a man following her.
Her body was found by police in a swamp near the school on Saturday morning.
The attack was the latest in a series of crimes on children to plague Germany and other parts of Europe.
Germans were horrified in September by the brutal rape and murder of a seven-year-old Bavarian schoolgirl by a convicted sex felon who had recently been released from detention.
The murder of seven-year-old Natalie Astner has prompted calls for chemical castration of paedophiles, stiffer sentencing and an end to early releases for sex offenders.

The mix of outrage and frustration in Germany in the wake of Natalie's death has been reminiscent of the mood in neighbouring Belgium, where investigators have uncovered a child porn ring allegedly run by a sex offender also released early from prison.
